episodes.title: Informal Trade Behind Wiregrass Restoration
episodes.blurb: Interviews with 20 Florida landowners, land managers, and conservation staff show wiregrass restoration runs on trust-based swaps of seed, burn crews, and equipment. Seed costs about $1,700 per pound, and goodwill, more than profit, drives the sharing.

citation.title: The informal economy of wiregrass production for longleaf pine restoration in Florida

episodes.title: Late Season Caribbean Hurricanes
episodes.blurb: Covers the October–November 2020 Atlantic hurricane finish, with five major hurricanes driven by low wind shear and warm western Caribbean water. A simple summer model using the ENSO longitude index and Atlantic warm pool would have predicted the surge.

citation.title: A Hyperactive End to the Atlantic Hurricane Season October–November 2020
citation.journal: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
